$comment: Portable hook definitions, mapped per host that supports hooks (Claude Code, Cursor — Codex has none). Scripts are Node so one implementation runs on every OS. The token-thrift pair implements Spotify's 'shunt' enforcement layer and ships ENABLED for Claude Code; they fail open and can be disabled here (then `harness install`). Threshold via env SPRHARNESS_MAX_READ_LINES (default 400). protect-secrets ships disabled — enable deliberately.

hooks.description: Blocks untargeted Read of files >400 lines; directs to the bulk-reader worker (token thrift).
Blocks cat/type/Get-Content full dumps of large files in Bash; directs to bulk-reader (token thrift).
Blocks the agent from reading or editing .env / secrets files.
